forward_only_scope.statement: This registration adds new evidence after V4/V5 and cannot rewrite, reopen, pool into, or supersede either accepted schedule.

research_questions.question: Does the frozen B/F/S admission protocol produce complete, calibrated task-local decisions across 24 paper-task clusters in four mechanism domains?
How heterogeneous are paired F-S operational-success and private-score differences across papers, tasks, and domains?
How do dependency-closed atom restoration, retained atom/token ratio, and measured execution cost trade against reliability on a frozen four-cluster subset?
Do the local decisions remain qualitatively stable across registered model families and SLA perturbations without claiming deterministic closed-model reproduction?

hypotheses.protocol_calibration: At least three of four planted-redundancy positive controls are admitted and all four destructive-core negative controls are rejected.
hypotheses.decision_coverage: At least 20 of 24 natural paper-task clusters yield a valid Admit or Reject decision rather than Invalid.
hypotheses.natural_admission: At least 8 of 24 frozen natural strict subsets are admitted, with at least one natural admission in three of four domains.
hypotheses.generalization_boundary: Failure of any threshold is a reportable falsification or limitation, not a reason to edit tasks, atoms, scorers, models, or private registries.

condition_meanings.B: same action scaffold and task with no paper-derived artifact
condition_meanings.S: frozen dependency-closed strict subset produced without private outcomes

primary_design.independent_inference_unit: paper-task cluster; the six blocks are paired repeated measurements, not 144 independent tasks

candidate_construction.full_artifact: F contains every atom registered as necessary to implement the bounded task, including hard contracts and guardrails.
primary_slice_rule: Build the source-addressed atom DAG and reject cycles or unresolved locators.
Identify dependency-maximal atoms that are not marked hard-contract, guardrail, or scorer-interface atoms.
Choose the last eligible atom by canonical source locator, then atom ID.
Remove that atom and any dependent atoms required by closure; S must remain nonempty and strict.
If no eligible strict subset exists, the cluster fails the static eligibility gate before provider execution.
required_bindings_before_pilot: source span and byte locator for each atom
F and S rendered artifact sha256

schedule.rule: Each paper-task cluster uses every B/F/S order exactly once across its six blocks.
schedule.global_interleave: Round-robin domains, then a deterministic hash order over paper_id, task_id, and block_id; no two tasks from one paper are adjacent when another domain remains available.
schedule.freeze_artifact: Stage 2.3 must materialize the complete global schedule and its sha256 before the first provider conversation.

scoring.operational_success: All hard contracts pass and private_score >= 0.90.

admission_sla.paired_margin_rule: S private_score >= F private_score - 0.05 within the matched block

decision_states.Admit: All SLA, completeness, source, dependency, and integrity fields pass.
decision_states.Reject: The run is complete and valid but one or more B/F/S sufficiency or paired-margin fields fail.
decision_states.Invalid: A required input, output, scorer call, digest, schedule binding, or terminal provider result is missing or corrupt after the registered retry policy.

scoring.invalid_is_orthogonal: Invalid is not a quadrant of F sufficiency by S sufficiency and is excluded from neither denominators nor failure reporting.

control_subset.positive_control: Add one source-addressed restatement atom that has no executable effect, then remove only that atom in S_positive.
control_subset.negative_control: Remove the lowest-ID hard-contract or core-computation atom and all closure dependents in S_negative.
control_subset.reuse: The matched primary B and F conversations are reused; each control S receives a fresh conversation.
control_subset.calibration_scope: Four independent positive and four independent negative task-level controls; block-level repetitions are not counted as independent labels.
control_subset.confusion_matrix_policy: Report exact task-level counts and binomial intervals in a table. Do not draw a confusion matrix or claim calibrated error rates unless a later forward amendment registers at least eight independent controls per class before outcomes.

atom_ladder_subset.construction: Starting from F, remove dependency-maximal eligible atoms in reverse canonical order. Each level is dependency closed, nonempty, and strictly nested; drop_1_primary is the primary S used in the main design.
atom_ladder_subset.reuse: The matched primary B and F conversations are reused; every additional S level receives a fresh conversation.
atom_ladder_subset.claim_scope: Secondary causal/mechanistic evidence on four registered clusters only; ladder results cannot replace or select the primary S.

model_ablation.claim_scope: Robustness across registered model slots; no general model ranking or deterministic equality claim.

resource_budget.budget_rule: Required experiments finish before optional model slots. Exhaustion produces budget_infeasible; it cannot change tasks, thresholds, seeds, or hypotheses.

non_retryable: model alias absent from provider registry
transport_and_failure_policy.semantic_rerun: forbidden; a completed provider response is never rerun because its score is low
transport_and_failure_policy.attempt_logging: Persist every transport attempt, elapsed time, HTTP/status class, provider request ID when available, and whether the terminal response was recovered.

analysis_contract.domain_weighting: Equal weight to each of four domains, equal weight to papers within domain, and preserve both tasks when a paper is resampled.

cluster_bootstrap.resampling_unit: paper within domain, carrying both tasks and all six paired blocks
cluster_bootstrap.interpretation: registered-benchmark sensitivity interval, not a population or distribution-free guarantee

analysis_contract.per_task_display: Show all six paired block outcomes; any whisker is descriptive and cannot turn six blocks into six independent paper-task units.
analysis_contract.multiple_comparisons: The primary S is the only candidate used for main admission claims. Atom ladders, model slots, SLA grids, and control diagnostics are secondary and cannot select the main result.
analysis_contract.missingness: Invalid and missing terminal outcomes remain visible in denominators. No complete-case deletion.

success_condition: The protocol-calibration, decision-coverage, and natural-admission hypotheses all pass under the frozen registry, while integrity checks pass and no destructive negative control is admitted.
falsification_condition: The forward claim is falsified or materially weakened if control calibration fails, fewer than 20 natural clusters yield valid decisions, fewer than 8 natural subsets are admitted, natural admissions cover fewer than three domains, or any post-outcome mutation occurs.
stage_2_3_entry_gate: This plan, the paper registry, model registry, and figure/statistical plan pass the deterministic verifier.
All Stage 2.2 artifacts are committed and pushed.
Every selected full text, adapter, atom DAG, F/S artifact, fixture registry, scorer, and global schedule has a recorded digest.
Provider aliases are preflighted without substituting unregistered aliases.
No provider experiment conversation has started.
